name: Alex Hunt
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Katy, Texas
about: Attorney Alex Hunt is the founder and owner of Hunt Law Firm, which has office locations in Katy, Cypress, Sugar Land, and League City, Texas. Serving clients across the Greater Houston area, Alex provides exceptional, client-focused representation to those who are going through a divorce or have some other family law issue they need to address, including adoptions, child custody and support, mediations, enforcements, LGBT relationships, high-asset divorces, domestic violence, paternity, and more.

In addition to handling all types of family law matters, Alex also provides comprehensive estate plans, including guardianships and conservatorships, living wills, powers of attorney, and other important protections.

Alex’s mission, since he founded Hunt Law Firm, is to provide zealous advocacy that is responsive to clients' needs. Clients can expect representation that protects important rights and assets. Just as importantly, clients can also expect sound counsel that guides clients through the legal pitfalls and allows them to make the important decisions throughout their case.

Alex's numerous achievements inside and outside the courtroom are the result of his passion for helping those who need it, keeping abreast of the latest legal knowledge and research, and the dedicated attention he gives each matter entrusted to him. Alex has several times been named Best Lawyer by the Katy Times and the Katy Area Chamber of Commerce. Hunt Law Firm has several times been named Best Law Firm in Katy and a Houston Best of the Best finalist by the Houston Chronicle.

Hunt Law Firm differentiates itself by utilizing the most state-of-the-art technology to communicate with clients, research the law, and present their case inside the courtroom. Since it establishment, Hunt Law Firm has helped thousands of families navigate Texas family courts, with a focus on presenting clients' cases in the most convincing yet cost effective manner possible.
